@9875 := "# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\nname: pages\n\non:\n  pull_request:\n  push:\n    branches: [main]\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: true\n\njobs:\n  studio:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 30\n    permissions:\n      contents: read\n      pull-requests: read\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2\n        with:\n          persist-credentials: false\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38\n        with:\n          node-version: '24'\n      - id: command\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: |\n            target/release/verdant_studio\n            target/release/verdant_readers\n            target/release/verdant_xml\n          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**', 'certified-readers/**', 'certified-xml/**') }}\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.npm\n          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1\n      # Restored on every run, not only when certified/ changed: the end-to-end propose-command step below\n      # exports with the attested lexlean binary, and a fresh cargo install does not reproduce its hash.\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3-rust-1.97.0\n      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)\n        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          [ \"$(sha256sum target/lexlean/bin/lexlean 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-64)\" = \"$(jq -r .lexlean.executable_sha256 certified/evidence/attestation.json)\" ] || { rm -rf target/lexlean; rustup toolchain install 1.97.0 --profile minimal; RUSTFLAGS=\"--remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=cargo-home\" cargo +1.97.0 install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean; }\n          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified\n          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n          # The reader operations are a second LexLean project with its own bundle, so that each export stays under its limits.\n          if [ -d certified-readers ]; then\n            target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified-readers\n            cargo build --release --manifest-path certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock\n          fi\n          # The XML readers are a third project with their own bundle, for the same reason.\n          if [ -d certified-xml ]; then\n            target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified-xml\n            cargo build --release --manifest-path certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.lock\n          fi\n          # Building may write only target/: a stray file in a bundle fails verify-artifact on the next run (LLV7102).\n          if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain -- certified certified-readers certified-xml)\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::building the certified commands left files in certified/, certified-readers/ or certified-xml/:\"\n            git status --short -- certified certified-readers certified-xml | head -20\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - name: check, build and publish through the API\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          target/release/verdant_studio check\n          # Each encoding admitted through admit-translated recorded the reader command that printed it: run it again and fail if the output differs.\n          target/release/verdant_readers verify-translations model/admissions.json\n          if [ -x target/release/verdant_xml ]; then target/release/verdant_xml verify-translations model/admissions.json; fi\n          target/release/verdant_studio build\n          target/release/verdant_studio publish\n          if ! git diff --quiet; then echo \"::error::publish changed $(git diff --name-only | tr '\\n' ' '): run every operation through operate, which ends with check, build and publish\"; exit 1; fi\n      - name: next answers within a second, because operate's advance runs it on every push to main\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          best=999999\n          for attempt in 1 2 3; do\n            start=$EPOCHREALTIME\n            target/release/verdant_studio next > target/next.txt || true\n            end=$EPOCHREALTIME\n            took=$(( (${end/./} - ${start/./}) / 1000 ))\n            if [ \"$took\" -lt \"$best\" ]; then best=$took; fi\n          done\n          echo \"next took ${best} ms, the best of 3 runs\"\n          if [ \"$best\" -gt 1000 ]; then echo \"::error::next took ${best} ms, over its 1 s budget: make the reads it repeats cheaper before adding more\"; exit 1; fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.elan\n          key: lean-4.32.2-elan-4.1.2\n      - name: run propose-command end to end when the pull request changes the API's own workflows\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          BASE: ${{ github.base_ref }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          # The studio check proves the model and replays the certified bundle, but the API's own paths\n          # run in these workflows. So a change to them must pass operate's propose-command step itself,\n          # on a fixture change, and that export must reproduce certified/ byte for byte.\n          git fetch -q --depth=1 origin \"$BASE\"\n          if git diff --quiet FETCH_HEAD -- .github; then echo \"the workflows are main's, which main's own runs exercise\"; exit 0; fi\n          mkdir -p target\n          python3 -c 'import yaml; steps = yaml.safe_load(open(\".github/workflows/operate.yml\"))[\"jobs\"][\"operate\"][\"steps\"]; print([step[\"run\"] for step in steps if step.get(\"name\", \"\").startswith(\"apply a change\")][0])' > target/propose.sh\n          d=dev\n          none=null\n          {\n            echo \"Fixture change for the studio check's end-to-end run of propose-command.\"\n            echo\n            echo \"diff --git a/features/suites/e2e.fixture b/features/suites/e2e.fixture\"\n            echo \"new file mode 100644\"\n            echo \"--- /$d/$none\"\n            echo \"+++ b/features/suites/e2e.fixture\"\n            echo \"@@ -0,0 +1 @@\"\n            echo \"+fixture\"\n          } > target/fixture.patch\n          INPUT=\"$(cat target/fixture.patch)\" bash target/propose.sh\n          rm -f features/suites/e2e.fixture\n          # certified-xml/ joins the comparison once main holds it: the export that first writes it is the one that adds it.\n          bundles=\"certified certified-readers\"\n          if [ -n \"$(git ls-files certified-xml | head -n 1)\" ]; then bundles=\"$bundles certified-xml\"; fi\n          if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain -- $bundles)\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::operate's propose-command step ran, but its export did not reproduce certified/:\"\n            git status --short -- $bundles | head -20\n            attested=$(git show HEAD:certified/evidence/attestation.json | jq -r .lexlean.executable_sha256); used=$(sha256sum target/lexlean/bin/lexlean | cut -c1-64)\n            [ \"$attested\" = \"$used\" ] || echo \"::error::the export ran with lexlean $used, but certified/ attests lexlean $attested. lexlean is built with rust 1.97.0 and its cargo home remapped, so a different hash means the toolchain or the runner image changed\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          echo \"propose-command applied the fixture, exported again with Lean and reproduced certified/ byte for byte\"\n      - name: accept only pull requests made through the API (last, so every seal step reports first)\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n          AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          app='afflom-verdant-studio[bot]'\n          if [ \"$AUTHOR\" != \"$app\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error title=provenance::$AUTHOR opened this pull request, not $app through operate. Every seal step above passed; only the provenance gate refuses it.\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          others=$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/commits\" --paginate --jq \".[] | select(.author.login != \\\"$app\\\") | .sha\")\n          if [ -n \"$others\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::these commits were not made by $app: $others\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'push'\n        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1\n        with:\n          path: app/.prism/site\n\n  pages:\n    if: github.event_name == 'push'\n    needs: studio\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    permissions:\n      pages: write\n      id-token: write\n    environment:\n      name: github-pages\n      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}\n    steps:\n      - id: deployment\n        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5\n"

@9995 := "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\n# The one Lean export of the certified command. operate's propose-command and refresh both run it,\n# and the studio check runs propose-command end to end, so a change that breaks it fails there.\n# Export time is a requirement: every Lean phase runs under child_timeout_ms (300 s, studio/lexlean.toml),\n# so this script measures each phase and fails at 240 s, 80 percent of that limit, before time can creep up to it.\nset -euo pipefail\nll=\"$1\"\nlog=\"$2\"\nphases=\"$log.phases\"\n: > \"$phases.raw\"\n( while :; do ps -eo etimes=,args= | awk '$2 == \"lean\" && $3 == \"-R\" { m = $NF; sub(\".*-src/\", \"\", m); print $1, m }' >> \"$phases.raw\" || true; sleep 1; done ) &\nwatch=$!\nstatus=0\n# Each LexLean project exports in parallel under its own limits: studio, readers and readers/xml when they exist.\n# Lean's proof of a project grows with the square of its function count, so the readers are split by family.\npids=\"\"\nfor project in studio readers readers/xml; do\n  if [ -f \"$project/lexlean.toml\" ]; then\n    (cd \"$project\" && \"$ll\" lock && \"$ll\" check && \"$ll\" production build --request production-request.json) > \"$log.${project//\\//-}\" 2>&1 &\n    pids=\"$pids $!\"\n  fi\ndone\nfor pid in $pids; do wait \"$pid\" || status=$?; done\ncat \"$log.studio\" > \"$log\"\nif [ -f \"$log.readers\" ]; then cat \"$log.readers\" >> \"$log\"; fi\nif [ -f \"$log.readers-xml\" ]; then cat \"$log.readers-xml\" >> \"$log\"; fi\nkill \"$watch\" 2> \"$phases.err\" || true\nawk '{ if ($1 > t[$2]) t[$2] = $1 } END { for (m in t) print t[m], m }' \"$phases.raw\" | sort -rn > \"$phases\"\necho \"Lean phases by wall time in seconds, longest first (the limit is 300, and the export fails at 240):\"\nhead -n 8 \"$phases\"\nif [ \"$status\" -ne 0 ]; then exit \"$status\"; fi\nworst=$(head -n 1 \"$phases\" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\nif [ -n \"$worst\" ] && [ \"$worst\" -ge 240 ]; then\n  echo \"::error::a Lean phase took ${worst} s, within 20 percent of the 300 s limit: make its declarations cheaper to prove before adding more\"\n  exit 1\nfi\nrm -rf certified\ncp -r studio/.lexlean/production/*/ certified\nrm -f certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.lock\n\"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified\nif [ -f readers/lexlean.toml ]; then\n  rm -rf certified-readers\n  cp -r readers/.lexlean/production/*/ certified-readers\n  rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock\n  \"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified-readers\nfi\nif [ -f readers/xml/lexlean.toml ]; then\n  rm -rf certified-xml\n  cp -r readers/xml/.lexlean/production/*/ certified-xml\n  rm -f certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.lock\n  \"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified-xml\nfi\n"

@15766 := @572 @15764 @545

@17597 := "            # The repair of a merge that broke the API's own path. Dispatched from a branch at the last\n"
@17598 := @762 @17597
@17599 := @761 @17598
@17601 := @572 @17599 @545
@17602 := @760 @17601
@17603 := @572 @17602
@17604 := "            # good main commit, it reverts the merge on main as the App, and merges once the studio check passes.\n"
@17605 := @762 @17604
@17606 := @761 @17605
@17608 := @572 @17606 @545
@17609 := @760 @17608
@17610 := @572 @17609
@17611 := "            merge=${ARGS#revert-merge }\n"
@17612 := @762 @17611
@17613 := @761 @17612
@17615 := @572 @17613 @545
@17616 := @760 @17615
@17617 := @572 @17616
@17618 := "            case \"$merge\" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo \"::error::revert-merge takes the full hex id of a merge commit on main\"; exit 1;; esac\n"
@17619 := @762 @17618
@17620 := @761 @17619
@17622 := @572 @17620 @545
@17623 := @760 @17622
@17624 := @572 @17623

@17629 := @572 @17627 @545
@17630 := @760 @17629
@17631 := @572 @17630
@17632 := "            git checkout -q -B revert origin/main\n"
@17633 := @762 @17632
@17634 := @761 @17633
@17636 := @572 @17634 @545
@17637 := @760 @17636
@17638 := @572 @17637
@17639 := "            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor \"$merge\" origin/main; then echo \"::error::$merge is not on main\"; exit 1; fi\n"
@17640 := @762 @17639
@17641 := @761 @17640
@17643 := @572 @17641 @545
@17644 := @760 @17643
@17645 := @572 @17644
@17646 := "            git revert -m 1 --no-commit \"$merge\"\n"
@17647 := @762 @17646
@17648 := @761 @17647
@17650 := @572 @17648 @545
@17651 := @760 @17650
@17652 := @572 @17651
@17653 := "            cargo build -q --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n"
@17654 := @762 @17653
@17655 := @761 @17654
@17657 := @572 @17655 @545
@17658 := @760 @17657
@17659 := @572 @17658
@17660 := "            if [ -d certified-readers ]; then cargo build -q --release --manifest-path certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock; fi\n"
@17661 := @762 @17660
@17662 := @761 @17661
@17664 := @572 @17662 @545
@17665 := @760 @17664
@17666 := @572 @17665
@17667 := "            if [ -d certified-xml ]; then cargo build -q --release --manifest-path certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-xml/packages/rust-std/verdant_xml/Cargo.lock; fi\n"

@17669 := @761 @17668
@17671 := @572 @17669 @545
@17672 := @760 @17671
@17673 := @572 @17672
@17674 := "            { echo \"Revert $merge, a merge that broke the API's own path\"; echo; echo \"**What changes and why.** This reverts the merge $merge on main $(git rev-parse --short origin/main), made by the App from the last good main commit, so the repair needs no bypass.\"; echo; echo '```'; git diff --cached --stat -- studio/src app/src model features README.md .github; echo '```'; } > target/operation.txt\n"
@17675 := @762 @17674

@17678 := @572 @17676 @545

@17685 := @572 @17683 @545
@17686 := @760 @17685

@17688 := "            vs $ARGS | tee target/operation.txt\n"

@17694 := @572 @17693

@17699 := @572 @17697 @545
@17700 := @760 @17699
@17701 := @572 @17700

@17703 := @762 @17702

@17706 := @572 @17704 @545
@17707 := @760 @17706
@17708 := @572 @17707
@17709 := "          target/release/verdant_studio publish\n"

@17715 := @572 @17714

@17720 := @572 @17718 @545
@17721 := @760 @17720
@17722 := @572 @17721

@17728 := @760 @17727
@17729 := @572 @17728

@17734 := @572 @17732 @545
@17735 := @760 @17734
@17736 := @572 @17735
@17737 := "          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo \"no change\"; exit 0; fi\n"
@17738 := @762 @17737
@17739 := @761 @17738
@17741 := @572 @17739 @545
@17742 := @760 @17741
@17743 := @572 @17742
@17744 := "          id=$(gh api \"users/${SLUG}[bot]\" --jq .id)\n"
@17745 := @762 @17744
@17746 := @761 @17745
@17748 := @572 @17746 @545
@17749 := @760 @17748
@17750 := @572 @17749
@17751 := "          git -c user.name=\"${SLUG}[bot]\" -c user.email=\"${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\" commit -q -F - <<MSG\n"
@17752 := @762 @17751
@17753 := @761 @17752
@17755 := @572 @17753 @545
@17756 := @760 @17755
@17757 := @572 @17756
@17758 := "          verdant_studio $ARGS\n"
@17759 := @762 @17758
@17760 := @761 @17759
@17762 := @572 @17760 @545
@17763 := @760 @17762
@17764 := @572 @17763
@17765 := "          $(cat target/operation.txt)\n"
@17766 := @762 @17765
@17767 := @761 @17766
@17769 := @572 @17767 @545
@17770 := @760 @17769
@17771 := @572 @17770
@17772 := "          MSG\n"
@17773 := @762 @17772
@17774 := @761 @17773
@17776 := @572 @17774 @545
@17777 := @760 @17776
@17778 := @572 @17777
@17779 := "          branch=\"studio/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n"
@17780 := @762 @17779
@17781 := @761 @17780
@17783 := @572 @17781 @545
@17784 := @760 @17783
@17785 := @572 @17784
@17786 := "          if ! git push origin \"HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}\" 2> target/push.err; then\n"
@17787 := @762 @17786
@17788 := @761 @17787
@17790 := @572 @17788 @545
@17791 := @760 @17790
@17792 := @572 @17791
@17793 := "            grep -E 'GH013|error|rejected|path:' target/push.err | head -20 | sed 's/^/::error::/'\n"

@17797 := @572 @17795 @545
@17798 := @760 @17797

@17804 := @572 @17802 @545
@17805 := @760 @17804
@17806 := @572 @17805

@17813 := @572 @17812
@17814 := "          if [ \"${ARGS#revert-merge }\" != \"$ARGS\" ]; then title=\"verdant_studio propose-command: Revert ${ARGS#revert-merge }, a merge that broke the API's own path\"; fi\n"

@17818 := @572 @17816 @545
@17819 := @760 @17818
@17820 := @572 @17819
@17821 := "          # REST, not GraphQL: run 45646779790 lost its pull request to four GraphQL errors.\n"
@17822 := @762 @17821
@17823 := @761 @17822
@17825 := @572 @17823 @545
@17826 := @760 @17825
@17827 := @572 @17826
@17828 := "          # Opening is idempotent: run 45649684941 opened #263 although its call reported an error, and the retry then failed on \"already exists\".\n"
@17829 := @762 @17828
@17830 := @761 @17829
@17832 := @572 @17830 @545
@17833 := @760 @17832
@17834 := @572 @17833
@17835 := "          # So each try first looks for an open pull request from this branch, and an existing one counts as opened.\n"
@17836 := @762 @17835
@17837 := @761 @17836
@17839 := @572 @17837 @545
@17840 := @760 @17839
@17841 := @572 @17840
@17842 := "          pr=\"\"\n"

@17844 := @761 @17843
@17846 := @572 @17844 @545
@17847 := @760 @17846
@17848 := @572 @17847
@17849 := "          for try in 1 2 3 4; do\n"

@17853 := @572 @17851 @545
@17854 := @760 @17853
@17855 := @572 @17854
@17856 := "            pr=$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&head=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}:${branch}\" --jq '.[0].number // empty')\n"
@17857 := @762 @17856

@17864 := @762 @17863
@17865 := @761 @17864
@17867 := @572 @17865 @545
@17868 := @760 @17867
@17869 := @572 @17868
@17870 := "            if pr=$(command gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" -f head=\"$branch\" -f base=main -f title=\"$title\" -F body=@target/operation.txt --jq .number) && [ -n \"$pr\" ]; then break; fi\n"

@17890 := @572 @17889

@17895 := @572 @17893 @545

@17897 := @572 @17896

@17907 := @761 @17906
@17909 := @572 @17907 @545
@17910 := @760 @17909
@17911 := @572 @17910
@17912 := "          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/rules/branches/main\" > target/rules.json\n"
@17913 := @762 @17912
@17914 := @761 @17913
@17916 := @572 @17914 @545
@17917 := @760 @17916
@17918 := @572 @17917
